title: Tidal will start banning AI-generated music next month
summary: Tidal is officially banning AI-generated music on December 9th. As a result of this change, Tidal will delete around 29 million AI-generated songs and reject an estimated 80,000 to 85,000 tracks per day, according to Tidal music lead Robert Andersen. The move comes just months af
reason: Tidal banning AI-generated music is a private platform's self-regulation, not a model release, research artifact, business event, government policy action, or OSS tool. Rule 4-1 explicitly excludes industry self-regulation.
